metadata.title: First Solar Stock Upgraded to Buy With $270 Target<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why First Solar Stock Just Got Upgraded
First Solar stock rose Monday after shares of the major solar panel manufacturer were upgraded to Buy even as the stock price has retreated sharply in recent months.
